name: NextBrill UploadMate: File upload for WooCommerce
author: NextBrill

sections.description:
UploadMate is a lightweight and user-friendly image upload plugin designed specifically for WooCommerce stores. Allow your customers to upload images directly on product pages and easily manage these uploads from your WordPress admin dashboard.

Perfect for businesses that need customers to provide custom images such as:
* Print shops requiring design artwork
* Custom merchandise stores needing logo images
* Photo services requiring customer images
* Any business where customer image uploads are essential

✨ Key Features

  • Simple Image Uploads: One-click image uploads on any WooCommerce product page
  • Secure Image Storage: Images are stored securely in a protected directory
  • Order Integration: Uploaded images are automatically linked to orders
  • Admin Dashboard: View and download customer images directly from order pages
  • Image Type Control: Support for JPG, JPEG, and PNG image formats
  • Size Limitations: Built-in configurable image size limit for optimal performance
  • Mobile Friendly: Responsive design works perfectly on all devices
  • Translation Ready: Fully prepared for internationalization

🚀 How It Works

  1. Customer uploads image: Customers can optionally upload images on any product page
  2. Image gets processed: The plugin securely stores the image and validates it
  3. Order connection: The uploaded image is automatically linked to the customer’s order
  4. Admin access: View and download customer images from the order dashboard

🎯 Perfect For

  • Print & Design Services: Custom t-shirts, business cards, banners
  • Photography Services: Photo editing, album creation
  • Document Services: Translation, proofreading, legal services
  • Custom Manufacturing: 3D printing, custom parts, personalized items
  • Educational Services: Assignment submissions, course materials

💎 UploadMate Pro

Ready for more advanced features? UploadMate Pro offers:

  • Enable uploads per individual product
  • Required uploads per product
  • Custom upload labels per product
  • Product-specific file types
  • Custom max files per product
  • Multiple files per product (up to 20)
  • Drag & drop upload interface
  • File preview and progress bars

Upgrade to UploadMate Pro →

🔧 Technical Details

  • Minimum Requirements: WordPress 5.0+, WooCommerce 4.0+, PHP 7.4+
  • Image Storage: Secure uploads directory with .htaccess protection
  • Image Types: JPG, JPEG, PNG
  • Image Size: Configurable maximum (UPTO 5MB)
  • Security: Nonce verification, file type validation, secure storage

Advanced Usage

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
  3. Search for “UploadMate”
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate
  5. The plugin will work immediately on all WooCommerce products

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the downloaded ZIP file and click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin
  5. Configure settings at Settings → UploadMate

Configuration

  1. Go to Settings → UploadMate
  2. Enable file uploads (enabled by default)
  3. Customize settings as needed
  4. Visit any product page to see the upload field
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with all WooCommerce themes?

Yes! UploadMate is designed to work with any properly coded WooCommerce theme. The upload field automatically appears before the “Add to Cart” button using standard WooCommerce hooks.

What image types are supported?

The free version supports JPG, JPEG, and PNG image formats. UploadMate Pro allows you to customize supported file types per product and includes additional formats.

Is there an image size limit?

Yes, the free version has a configurable image size limit (default 5MB). This can be customized in the WooCommerce settings, and you can also adjust your server’s upload limits.

Where are uploaded files stored?

Files are stored in a secure directory (/wp-content/uploads/uploadmate/) with .htaccess protection to prevent direct access while still allowing admin downloads.

Can I make image uploads required?

Image uploads are optional in the free version. UploadMate Pro allows you to make uploads required on a per-product basis.

Will this slow down my website?

No! UploadMate is lightweight and only loads its scripts on product pages. Files are uploaded via AJAX without page reloads.

Is it compatible with caching plugins?

Yes, UploadMate works with all major caching plugins including WP Rocket, W3 Total Cache, and WP Super Cache.

Can customers upload multiple images?

The free version allows one image per product. UploadMate Pro supports up to 20 images per product with a drag-and-drop interface.

How do I access uploaded images?

Uploaded images appear in the order details page in your WordPress admin. You can view and download them directly from there. Customer also see clickable image names in their order details.

Is the plugin GDPR compliant?

Yes, UploadMate follows WordPress and WooCommerce data handling practices. Customer images are only stored when they choose to upload them, and no data is sent to external servers.
